join: MHRA drug and device alert (or FSN weekly-list entry) -> openFDA drug/device enforcement report by firm core token + shared product token + date window; verdict = same recall event (same product/model and defect, dates aligned). FSN entries carry no hazard text on GOV.UK, so they are judged on manufacturer, device, model and FSN date; uncertain counts as not correct.

citations_of_other_agencies.note: 1 DSI (M6-C cervical disc, 2025-01-15) cites a paper on FDA Medical Device Reports, not an FDA recall notice; no alert mentions Health Canada
